sprint: Sprint 3 — Ledger query/export + dual-key unmask + Management read-models
rationale: Needs a populated ledger (S1) and request entries (S2). US-016 query underpins US-017 export and the US-019/021 read-models. US-017 (verifiable evidence bundle) is the artefact that closes a sale and satisfies the month-long-chain acceptance test. US-031 (dual-key actor unmask, AF-408 — NG-20) fits here: it reuses the governance writer + pseudonym HMAC and is the mechanism that makes the Betriebsvereinbarung signable (§8 A3); its secret store stays deferred to E8. US-019/021 are aggregated read-models with NO person column (NG-13). US-023 wires the export into the management view.
acceptance_gate: actor-pseudonymisation (export shows actorPseudonym, no plaintext id)
